What do feminists mean by the 'dark side' of family life?
options: It is treated more harshly than street crime.

The reality that families can be sites of inequality, exploitation and violence — particularly affecting women and children — challenging functionalist portrayals of the family as universally beneficial.
The 'dark side' refers to families who live in poverty.
The 'dark side' is a metaphor about families who don't communicate.

mcqs.q: What is the Marxist view on white-collar crime?
options: It is widespread but under-policed because law serves ruling-class interests.
The 'dark side' is a metaphor about families who don't communicate.
It does not really happen - only the working class commit crime.
It is treated more harshly than street crime.

mcqs.q: What is cultural capital according to Bourdieu?
options: The amount of money parents spend on culture.
It is treated more harshly than street crime.
Cultural knowledge, tastes, and skills that confer advantage in education and society.
Government funding for the arts.
